primitives.name: Duplicate Dependency Validator
primitives.verbatim_quote: # EDGE-022: No-live-prizes release gate ## Duplicate Gate duplicate_check_status: DEPENDENCY matched_existing_ids: CONTEST-015, EDGE-001 relation_to_existing: Required gate before downstream contest work.
primitives.assumptions: All dependencies must be resolved prior to downstream execution; no partial activation allowed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When D = false or R = false, system enters restricted mode.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's legal risk model where dependency resolution implies compliance readiness.
layer2.telemetry: Dependency resolution log and downstream task trigger.

primitives.name: Legal Risk Boundary Enforcer
primitives.verbatim_quote: Do not launch paid contests, prizes, deposits, payouts, live leaderboards, sportsbook/DFS affiliate flows, or real-money entries without founder/legal approval.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'L': 'legal approval status (boolean)', 'F': 'feature type (paid_contest | prize | deposit | payout | leaderboard | affiliate | real_money)', 'T': 'time of launch (timestamp)'}
primitives.assumptions: Feature activation requires L = true; otherwise, T is invalid.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If L = false, any F ∈ {paid_contest, prize, ...} triggers failure.

layer2.mapping: Derives from GSE's runtime safety kernel that blocks unsafe feature transitions.
layer2.telemetry: Feature activation attempt logs and legal approval timestamps.

primitives.name: Data Isolation Validator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Do not import real friend-history data without explicit consent and deletion controls.
primitives.assumptions: D_r = true iff C = true AND D_c = true.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If D_r = true but ¬(C ∧ D_c), system halts.

layer2.mapping: Mirrors GSI’s privacy constraint enforcement via data access tokens.
layer2.telemetry: Real data import attempts and consent/deletion audit trail.
